summary: The source inventory contains no Ağrı-specific statute, ordinance, enforcement action, incident, institution or official statement. No province-level signal was identified for Ağrı, and the national assessment for Türkiye applies to a trans visitor in the province.
tangentialFactors: The national material in the inventory — the draft judicial package reported in October 2025 and the 2025 violation counts compiled by an LGBTI+ rights organisation — carries no provincial disaggregation, so no adjacent or comparative pattern specific to Ağrı or to neighbouring provinces can be described from these sources.
localsOnly: No resident-facing facts specific to Ağrı — provincial policing practice, local administrative measures, healthcare provision or facility rules — are recorded in the source inventory.
outOfScopeNotes: Whether the draft judicial package has been enacted remains unresolved in the sources. No official hate-crime statistics are maintained at national level, and the published violation counts are not broken down by province, so Ağrı cannot be characterised separately from the national picture on the available material.
